display.purpose: The page H1 in every hero, white over the wash with a soft navy text shadow; home steps up to clamp(2.4rem, 5.6vw, 4.4rem) at 1.04, articles use clamp(2.05rem, 3.7vw, 3.1rem) at 1.08.

headline-feature.purpose: The statement heading that opens a major section (two paths, what TRE™ is, certification, get listed).

title.purpose: H3; card and list titles run 1.1–1.3rem at a 1.25–1.3 line height.

body.purpose: Inter reading text in ink, secondary copy in ink 2, held to a 56–68ch measure.

body-lead.purpose: The first paragraph under a heading; the hero lede runs at 1.16rem.

body-article.purpose: Reading mode for the six articles: a 66ch measure in a 720px column.

quote.purpose: Article pull quotes in navy under a drawn gold wave; closing quotes on navy switch to italic 700.

button.purpose: Sentence-case button labels; nav links use 600 at 0.92rem with no tracking.

label.purpose: Uppercase data labels only (facts-band terms, requirement tags); never a kicker above a heading.

badge.purpose: Uppercase location and category pills, at most two per card.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Cards, sidebar boxes, strip photos and toolbars at rest (--shadow-1).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Card hover; photo windows, featured panels and the map (--shadow-2).

shadows.name: primary-rest
shadows.purpose: The orange action at rest: neutral offset depth, never an orange glow.

shadows.name: navy-hover
shadows.purpose: Navy buttons on hover; outline buttons use the same shadow at .18.

shadows.name: facts-band
shadows.purpose: The facts strip that overlaps the foot of a record hero.

shadows.name: deep-panel
shadows.purpose: Navy illustrative panels sitting on light grounds.

shadows.name: hero-window
shadows.purpose: A poster or portrait window over the hero photograph.

shadows.name: indicator
shadows.purpose: The sliding navy thumb of a segmented control.

shadows.name: node-ring
shadows.purpose: State ring on a lit or active node (5–7px at 16–30%); state, not elevation.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Text field focus ring, with the border turning navy.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out (--ease-out): lifts, entrances, draws, indicators, arrow slides.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Colour, background, border and shadow cross-fades (--ease).

motion.name: ease-breath
motion.purpose: The hero photo push-in only (--ease-breath).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour and underline changes, press feedback (--d1).

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Button and card lifts, fills, shadows, arrow slides (--d2). The direction contract targeted 180–260ms hovers; the build runs 180–320ms.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Primary sheen sweep, scroll reveals, node fills (--d3).

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Only things that open or press lift.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons, tabs and chips; small tick controls press to .94–.96. No springs.

motion.name: button-pointer
motion.value: 150px radial glow at 18% of the label colour; magnetic lean up to 5px x / 3px y, settling over 450ms (120ms linear while tracking)
motion.purpose: Fine pointers only; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: ripple
motion.purpose: Pointer-down feedback on buttons.

motion.name: sheen
motion.purpose: One sweep across the orange action on hover.

motion.name: hero-push
motion.purpose: Breath-paced push-in on the hero photo.

motion.name: hero-parallax
motion.value: up to 8px x / 5px y, lerp 0.08 per frame; windows counter-drift at 0.6x
motion.purpose: Pointer parallax on the hero photo (fine pointers).

motion.name: hero-lens
motion.value: 280px radius, lerp 0.1; wash mask 38% at centre, 62% at mid-radius
motion.purpose: Thins the wash over the photo side (pointer x past 50%), never over links, buttons or the window.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: 950ms ease-out, 14px rise out of a 6px blur, 90ms stagger; credit 1.2s after 600ms
motion.purpose: The hero copy settles in; visible by default.

motion.name: tremor-field
motion.value: 7 lines, band 0.56–0.95 of the hero (0.62 on home); gold/bronze 1.5px, alpha .18–.45; amplitude 17px, wavelength 360–640px, 8s breath (0.62–1.0); pointer reach 150px, shiver 7px, rise rate 9/s, settle rate 2.3/s (~1.2s); resting shiver under the left 46% at 0.5; stroke at full alpha to fadeEnd - 0.21 and gone at fadeEnd (default 0.46 of the hero width, per hero via --lines-end: contact .44, blog and workday article .38), so no line crosses a face; idle pulse every 9s
motion.purpose: The signature interaction (TRELayer.tremor defaults plus the hero options). Lines shake under the copy column only. Pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; one still frame under reduced motion.

motion.name: draw-once
motion.purpose: Any [data-draw] path draws as it enters.

motion.name: draw-scroll
motion.value: tip follows a reading line at 60% of the viewport
motion.purpose: [data-draw=scroll] rails and timelines fill as you read.

motion.name: parallax
motion.purpose: [data-parallax] photos drift a few pixels against the scroll.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 600ms ease-out, 16px rise out of a 4px blur, 70ms stagger, threshold 0.12, 2.5s failsafe
motion.purpose: Section entrances, armed by script only; no-JS pages stay sharp and complete.

motion.name: indicator-slide
motion.purpose: Segmented-control thumbs and tab inks.

motion.name: details-open
motion.purpose: Accordion answers open by height (interpolate-size).

motion.name: menu-sheet
motion.value: clip-path circle from the toggle, 550–600ms ease-out; links 500ms, 40ms stagger
motion.purpose: The phone navigation sheet (980px and below).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: A fully still, complete page: drawn lines complete, the tremor field one still frame, the menu sheet simply appears.

narrative.overview:
The site acts out TRE™ instead of describing it. Every page opens on a real session room (wood floors, mats, garden light) seen sharp through a navy colour grade and a navy-ink wash. Across the lower band of the copy side runs a field of fine bronze and gold tremor lines that shake under the words, tremble again wherever the pointer passes, and fade out just past the copy, so no line ever crosses a face in the photograph: charge, release, settle, readable even in a still frame. Below the hero the page turns calm, on paper and cream grounds, where the same lines return as drawn rails, flows and node rings that draw once as they enter. Every page ends on a navy close that offers both paths: a provider or an event for newcomers, the certification intake call for professionals.

This is a precisely specified extension of the incumbent TRE Singapore world, not a replacement. The palette comes from the logo (navy wordmark, globe blue, bronze eagle and continents, brown "Singapore") plus the existing orange call-to-action colour. The type is technext.asia's Plus Jakarta Sans over Inter, made binding by the user on 2026-09-29. Density is moderate and editorial: a 1180px column, a 96px section rhythm, photographs in 16px windows, and hairline-ruled lists where other sites would reach for boxed tiles.

Motion is rich but regulated, because the audience is looking for relief from stress. It is breath-paced in the hero, drawn once in sections and eased out everywhere else, with no springs and no bounce. Everything is visible by default and completely still under reduced motion. The world refuses the flat navy banner with decorative blobs, the stock or blurred wellness photograph, one fade-up repeated on every section, eyebrow labels, stat-tile rows and icon-card grids.
keyCharacteristics: Real, sharp session photography graded toward navy under a wash that is densest on the copy side, with a provenance credit on every hero.
Bronze and gold are the only drawn colour: hairlines, tremor strokes, flow lines, rails and node rings.
Orange fills the one primary action in view and carries a navy-ink label.
Navy-tinted neutrals on paper and cream; navy ink carries heroes, illustrative panels and closes.
Plus Jakarta Sans 700 headings, with at most one italic accent phrase, over Inter 16px/1.65 text.
Drawn SVG line icons at a 1.75px round stroke; never text glyphs.
One signature interaction, the tremor field; sections draw once and then hold still.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange fills exactly one action per view: the page's primary. Record cards, rails and agenda rows repaint their primaries navy; while any other orange primary is on screen, the header's "Book a call" steps back to navy; on touch screens every directory card shows a navy "Book now". Orange is never a surface, a badge, a glow or a text colour.

rules.name: The Navy-Ink Label Rule
rules.body: Every orange primary carries a navy-ink label (6.1:1 on the fill, 4.57:1 on the hover fill). White on orange measures 2.7:1 and never ships. The label is set in CSS on the primary itself, so it holds without JavaScript, and any rule that repaints a primary navy sets its own white label at rest and on hover.

rules.name: The Drawn Gold Rule
rules.body: Bronze and gold are the only colours that draw: hairlines, tremor and wave strokes, rails, node rings and icons. Gold never sets text on paper or cream (2.35:1); on light grounds the text accent is bronze. Gold text sits on navy ink or deep navy, not on mid navy (4.48:1, just under the floor).

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: No text is ever pure grey. On light grounds text is ink, ink 2 or muted; on navy it is white, on-navy or on-navy soft.

rules.name: The Heading Speaks Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker line ever sits above a heading. The uppercase label style belongs to data (facts, table heads, badges), never to an introduction; in record heroes the badges follow the H1.

rules.name: The One Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: A heading carries at most one italic accent phrase: gold on navy, bronze on light.

rules.name: The Ruled List Rule
rules.body: Lists of offers, values, inclusions, kinds and checks are hairline-ruled rows (1px line) with a drawn icon or node, never a grid of same-size boxed tiles.

rules.name: The Neutral Depth Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is navy-tinted, offset and softly blurred. The orange action gets the same neutral depth as everything else, never an orange glow, and a zero-offset glow is never used as depth.

rules.name: The Window Rule
rules.body: A photograph is either full-bleed under the hero wash or clipped inside a rounded window with a navy-ink backing. It is never a geometric cut-out.

rules.name: The Charge-Release-Settle Rule
rules.body: Every tremor surface reads charge, release and settle in a still frame: energy under the words, gone before the image. Pointer energy always decays back to rest.

rules.name: The Clear Faces Rule
rules.body: No tremor line may cross a face in the photograph. Hero lines shake under the copy column only and fade out by 46% of the width; a hero with people nearer the copy pulls that end in further.

rules.name: The Both-Paths Close Rule
rules.body: The close always offers both routes: a provider or an event for newcomers, and the intake call for professionals. The two paths are visibly separate (a 1px hairline, a drawn fork, or two equal buttons), and at most one of them is orange.

dos: Do open every page on a real session photograph, sharp, graded to navy (colour blend at 42%) under a wash densest on the copy side, with the tremor band under the copy (never across a face) and a provenance credit.
Do keep exactly one orange primary in view, give it a navy-ink label (#0f1f3d), and repaint card, rail and agenda primaries navy.
Do draw with bronze and gold only: hairlines, rails that fill with gold, node rings, and the settled wave lines on a close.
Do end every page on a navy close that offers both paths.
Do use drawn SVG line icons at a 1.75px round stroke, bronze on light and gold on navy.
Do keep text navy-tinted: ink, ink 2 or muted on light; white, #dbe3f1 or #cdd8ea on navy.

Do move on the exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)): 180ms for colour, 320ms for lifts and fills, press to 0.98. Draw sections once; keep everything visible by default and still under reduced motion.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and the 3px gold focus ring at a 3px offset.
Do use the official TRE Singapore logo lockup exactly as supplied.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading.
Don't build stat-tile rows or big-number hero metrics; a figure reads as a word inside its sentence.
Don't build grids of same-size cards made of an icon, a heading and a line of text.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji (→, +, ×) as icons; arrows, plus signs, chevrons and closes are drawn masks.
Don't use gradient text; emphasis comes from weight, size or the single italic accent.
Don't give cards, callouts or list items a coloured side stripe thicker than 1px.
Don't blur the hero photograph or float drifting decorative blobs over it.
Don't set white labels on orange (2.7:1) or gold text on paper or cream (2.35:1).
Don't use orange as a surface, badge, glow or text colour.
Don't use stock or invented people; every photograph shows a real TRE™ room or trainer.
Don't use springs, bounce, or one identical fade-up on every section.
Don't use glass blur (backdrop-filter) or add hues beyond this palette; the one outside colour is WhatsApp's own green on its chat button.
